mapper.select: SELECT QUESTION_SEQ as questionSeq, EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, QUESTION_TYPE as questionType, QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL as questionTypeDetail, QUESTION as question, QUESTION_IMG as questionImg, ORD as `order`, FOREIGN_ALLOW as foreignAllow, REG_DATE as regDate, REG_ID as regId FROM SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} ORDER BY ORD ASC

SELECT QUESTION_SEQ as questionSeq, EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, QUESTION_TYPE as questionType, QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL as questionTypeDetail, QUESTION as question, QUESTION_IMG as questionImg, ORD as `order`, FOREIGN_ALLOW as foreignAllow, REG_DATE as regDate, REG_ID as regId FROM SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE QUESTION_SEQ = #{questionSeq}
SELECT DISTINCT QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL FROM SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL IN ('NE', 'CU', 'SO', 'EM', 'AD')
